modelingNotes: San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge, West Bay Crossing: the inner towers W3 and W5, beside the centre anchorage — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/sf-bay-bridge-west-inner.ts

The same tower as `sf-bay-bridge-west` (W2, W6), built by its generator: 13.6 m taller (cap plates at 498.2 ft against 453.5 ft above MLLW, HAER drawing 382; lidar hood tops 156.9 m against 143.4 m), the extra length all below the deck, which crosses these towers 13.5 m higher, and the legs' foot flaring wider along the bridge (31 ft 7 in over 172 ft). Sources, estimates and doubts are in that file's header.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "sf-bay-bridge-west-w5", model "sf-bay-bridge-west-inner"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/sf-bay-bridge-west-inner.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
